results.title: Appeals court rules Trump can't build White House ballroom without congressional approval
results.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — A federal appeals court on Friday ordered the Trump administration to halt construction of its $400 million ballroom at the White House without congressional approval.

results.title: Appeals court rules Trump must get approval from Congress on ballroom, ordering halt to construction
results.description: An appeals court has ruled that President Donald Trump must seek approval from Congress to build his proposed White House ballroom, saying construction must stop. The U.S. Court of Appeals sided with historic preservationists who sued to stop construction. The court said it would stay its own ruling for two weeks to allow the administration to appeal to the U.S. Supreme Court.
